name: create_level_sequence
purpose: Mint a new, saveable ULevelSequence asset at a given package path — currently no cinematic can be authored at all.
cooked: n/a — always creates a new loose asset; refuses pak-mounted target paths

name: describe_sequence
purpose: One-call structured dump of any UMovieSceneSequence: ranges, rates, bindings with GUIDs, tracks, sections, channel inventory.
cooked: works — MovieScene data survives cooking intact; pak-mounted sequences fully readable

name: sequence_bind_actor
purpose: Bind a placed level actor into a sequence as a possessable or spawnable, returning the binding GUID track endpoints key off.
cooked: refuses — pak-mounted sequence is unsaveable; duplicate_asset to a loose path first

name: sequence_add_track
purpose: Add a typed track (transform, float/bool property, visibility, UMG 2DTransform/Margin) to a binding or sequence root.
cooked: refuses — pak-mounted sequence unsaveable; fine on loose
hazards: SetDisplayName is inside #if WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA — displayName code path must sit under that guard

name: sequence_add_section
purpose: Give a track an actual section with a frame range — tracks evaluate nothing without one.

name: sequence_set_keys
purpose: Batch-write keys into a section's channels — transform XYZ, float/double properties, bools — turning the object model into animation.
hazards: 3DTransformSection channel members are private UPROPERTYs — access only via GetChannelProxy

name: open_sequence_editor
purpose: Open (or close) a level sequence in the Sequencer editor so a human or capture_camera can see what the agent authored.
cooked: works — cooked sequences open read-only; response flags cooked:true

name: sequence_editor_play
purpose: Drive the open Sequencer: play/pause/scrub/speed — step a cinematic to a frame and capture_camera it.

name: render_movie_request
purpose: Queue a Movie Render Pipeline job for a sequence+map — turns authored cinematics into video/image output, headless.
cooked: works — cooked sequence + cooked map render fine (evaluation-only)
hazards: FMessageDialog modal in PIEExecutor::Start (cpp:93/:109) runs sync in handler — pre-validate first
Must pre-check: sequence loads as ULevelSequence, map saved (IsMapValidForRemoteRender)
GetQueue is the shared singleton editor queue — clear stale jobs before allocating
Spawns a PIE session and multi-frame async work — must not sit inside any transaction
UMoviePipelinePrimaryConfig settings layout still UNVERIFIED — read MoviePipelineOutputSetting.h first

name: render_movie_status
purpose: Poll a queued Movie Render Pipeline job: {isRendering, finished, success, outputDirectory, filesWritten}.

name: list_widget_tree
purpose: One-call enumeration of a Widget Blueprint's whole widget hierarchy — closes roadmap gap 'UMG: no one-call tree enumeration'.
cooked: degraded — generated-class template tree walkable; editor-only bindings/animations metadata absent
hazards: Cooked branch depends on UNVERIFIED UWidgetBlueprintGeneratedClass accessor — implement loose path first

name: reparent_widget
purpose: Move an existing widget to a new parent panel and/or child index WITHOUT destroying it.
cooked: refuses — no UWidgetBlueprint to edit on pak-mounted UI
prevents: Today remove+add loses identity, bindings, and every property edit (roadmap :74-75)
hazards: InsertChildAt/ShiftChild/ReplaceChildAt call sites must be written under #if WITH_EDITOR
Slot properties reset to new panel's slot defaults — response must list new slot class (not silent)

name: rename_widget

cooked: refuses — no UWidgetBlueprint on pak-mounted UI
prevents: Only current route (remove+add) silently breaks variable refs, delegate and animation bindings

Replica must include tail steps cpp:400-428: possessable SetName, Navigation rename, ValidateBlueprintChildVariables, MarkStructurallyModified
Route new name through SanitizeWidgetName before validation (cpp:292)
FKismetNameValidator class unexported — only method-level UNREALED_API members link

name: create_widget_animation
purpose: Add a UWidgetAnimation to a Widget Blueprint — the container that makes UMG animation authoring possible at all.
hazards: Blueprint->Animations write sits inside #if WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA — member write belongs under that guard
Must also SetDisplayLabel + Rename the animation (cpp:601-602) so display name matches object name
Reports requiresCompile:true — agent must run the existing compile endpoint afterwards

name: widget_animation_bind
purpose: Bind a named widget (or widget slot) into a widget animation and return the possessable GUID.
hazards: UWidgetAnimation::BindPossessableObject CastChecked-asserts on null Context headless — append AnimationBindings struct directly
Slot binding: SlotWidgetName = the UPanelSlot object's FName (cpp:182), NOT the parent panel's name
